definition: This dimension controls the rate at which experience points are gained and how they translate into character levels, affecting the overall power progression in relation to dungeon threats. Variations can include linear, exponential, or logarithmic growth rates of experience gain.
exclusion_criteria: Experience points that do not relate to level advancement
inclusion_criteria: Experience points awarded for combat and exploration
Leveling impacts character abilities and stats
title: Experience Point Curve Variability
